explanation_sections.title: Compound Proportions and Rates of Work
explanation_sections.body:
A rate of work describes how much work is completed per unit of time. If 4 equally productive workers
finish a job in 12 days, the work equals 48 worker-days, so 6 workers would need 8 days.
